revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.9%, FY2024 0.1%; modest recovery to mid-single-digit growth, fading toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 17.4% (7746/44556); slight expansion from productivity and declining amortization.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. mid-teens effective rate; tax expense not pulled from filing, so flagged as an estimate.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = Rf 4.86% (US 10Y, Treasury 2026-11-06) + beta ~1.0 assumed x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) ~9.3%; after-tax cost of debt ~4.5%; ~85/15 equity/debt weights give ~8%. Beta not pulled from industry data.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal GDP growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack derived: total debt 39,385 (ltd_noncurrent 35,852 + debt_current 3,533) - cash 9,852 - ST investments 253; acc. 0000097745-26-000018
